ja: 今日の午後だけ、共有のビルドサーバーの設定を変えさせてもらってもいいでしょうか？
en: Would it be okay if I changed the shared build server's settings just for this afternoon?
alternatives: Is it okay if I change the shared build server's settings just for this afternoon?
Could I change the settings on the shared build server just for this afternoon?
point: Would it be okay if の後は過去形 changed にする

ja: このプロジェクトにセットアップ用のスクリプトってありますか？
en: Is there a setup script for this project?
alternatives: Does this project have a setup script?
Is there a script for setting up this project?
point: 「〜ある？」は Is there 〜? で主語は後ろ

ja: ローカルで Docker を動かすとメモリをどれだけ食うか、セットアップする前に知っておけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd known how much memory Docker would eat up locally before I set it up.
alternatives: If only I'd known how much memory Docker would use locally before I set it up.
I wish I had realized how much memory Docker takes up locally before setting it up.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish の後を過去完了 I'd known にする

ja: リードエンジニアが先週、全員のノートPCに同じエディタを入れました。
en: The lead engineer installed the same editor on everyone's laptop last week.
alternatives: Last week, the lead engineer installed the same editor on everyone's laptop.
The lead engineer put the same editor on everyone's laptop last week.
point: 入れる先は on everyone's laptop。in にしない

ja: 先週 Docker は入れたんだけど、ボリュームの共有方法はまだわかってないんだ。
en: I set up Docker last week, but I still haven't figured out how to share volumes.
alternatives: I installed Docker last week, but I still haven't worked out how to share volumes.
I got Docker set up last week, but I haven't figured out how to share volumes yet.
point: last week は過去形、「まだ〜ない」は現在完了で

ja: 最近、やっとターミナルでコマンドを打つのに慣れてきたよ。
en: I'm finally getting used to typing commands in the terminal.
alternatives: I'm finally getting used to entering commands in the terminal.
I'm finally getting comfortable typing commands in the terminal.
point: get used to の to は前置詞、後ろは typing

ja: 新しく入った人が初日にインストールしなきゃいけないツールをまとめたリストって、どこかにありますか？
en: Is there a list somewhere of the tools that new hires need to install on their first day?
alternatives: Do we have a list anywhere of the tools new hires have to install on their first day?
Is there a list somewhere of the tools new people need to install on day one?
point: a list of the tools の後ろに that 節を続けて名詞を修飾する

ja: 私は今、エディタに新しい拡張機能をインストールしているところです。
en: I'm installing a new editor extension now.
alternatives: I'm installing a new extension for my editor now.
Right now I'm installing a new editor extension.
point: 「今〜しているところ」は現在進行形 I'm 〜ing

ja: リンターは保存するたびに自動で走るけど、型チェックはコミットするときだけ走るように設定してあります。
en: I've set it up so that the linter runs automatically every time you save, whereas the type check only runs when you commit.
alternatives: I've configured it so the linter runs automatically whenever you save, while the type check only runs on commit.
I've set it up so the linter runs automatically each time you save, but the type check runs only when you commit.
point: 対比は whereas で2つの設定を並べる

ja: 自分のノートパソコンだと Docker が使えないんです。
en: I can't use Docker on my laptop.
alternatives: I'm not able to use Docker on my laptop.
Docker doesn't work on my laptop.
point: can't の後の動詞は原形の use

ja: Docker を入れたら、このコマンドを実行してください。
en: Please run this command once you've installed Docker.
alternatives: Run this command after you install Docker.
After you've installed Docker, please run this command.
point: 「入れたら」は完了後なので once you've installed で

ja: 新しいメンバーに、VS Code の拡張機能を入れるように伝えてもらえますか？
en: Could you tell the new member to install the VS Code extensions?
alternatives: Can you tell the new member to install the VS Code extensions?
Could you ask the new member to install the VS Code extensions?
point: tell + 人 + to install の形。that 節にしない

ja: うちのチームは毎日 GitHub を使っています。
en: Our team uses GitHub every day.
alternatives: Our team works with GitHub every day.
We use GitHub every day.
point: team は三人称単数なので uses と s を付ける

ja: もし彼女がもっと速いマシンを持っていたら、テストを全部ローカルで回せるのにね。
en: If she had a faster machine, she could run all the tests locally.
alternatives: She could run all the tests locally if she had a faster machine.
If she had a faster computer, she'd be able to run all the tests locally.
point: 現実と違う仮定なので had と could の過去形を使う

ja: このエディタを 3 年使ってきたけど、こんなに便利な拡張機能は一度も見たことがないよ。
en: I've used this editor for three years, but I've never seen such a useful extension.
alternatives: I've been using this editor for three years, and I've never come across an extension this useful.
I've used this editor for three years and have never seen an extension as useful as this.
point: 「3年使ってきた」「見たことがない」はどちらも現在完了

ja: インフラチームって、VPN につながないと僕たちはステージング環境に入れないって言ってたっけ？
en: Did the infra team say we couldn't access the staging environment unless we were connected to the VPN?
alternatives: Did the infrastructure team say we couldn't get into the staging environment unless we were on the VPN?
Didn't the infra team say we couldn't access staging without connecting to the VPN?
point: say の後は時制を合わせて couldn't / were にする

ja: 昨日ビルドが失敗したとき、私はもうキャッシュを消してありました。
en: I had already cleared the cache when the build failed yesterday.
alternatives: When the build failed yesterday, I had already cleared the cache.
I'd already deleted the cache by the time the build failed yesterday.
point: 失敗より前に消していたので had cleared にする

ja: チームに展開する前に、リンターをどう設定したか順を追って説明してもらえますか？
en: Could you walk me through how you set up the linter before we roll it out to the team?
alternatives: Before we roll it out to the team, could you walk me through how you configured the linter?
Could you take me through how you set up the linter before we roll it out to the whole team?
point: walk me through ＋ how 節は疑問文の語順にしない

ja: 新しいノート PC のセットアップについて、何かアドバイスある？特にどの拡張機能を入れればいいか知りたいんだ。
en: Do you have any advice on setting up a new laptop? I'd especially like to know which extensions I should install.
alternatives: Any advice on setting up a new laptop? I especially want to know which extensions to install.
Have you got any advice for setting up a new laptop? In particular, I'd like to know which extensions I should install.
point: advice は数えられないので an advice や advices にしない

ja: たとえ急ぎの修正でも、本番用の設定ファイルを直接編集するのはやめてもらえますか？
en: Even if it's an urgent fix, could you please not edit the production config file directly?
alternatives: Even when it's an urgent fix, could you avoid editing the production config file directly?
Could you please not edit the production config file directly, even if it's an urgent fix?
point: 「たとえ〜でも」は even if、依頼の否定は could you not

ja: 僕のマシンでビルドが通らなかった原因は、設定ファイルじゃなくて古い Node のバージョンだったんだ。
en: It was the outdated Node version, not the config file, that broke the build on my machine.
alternatives: What broke the build on my machine was the outdated Node version, not the config file.
It wasn't the config file but the old Node version that broke the build on my machine.
point: It was A, not B, that 〜 で原因を強調する

ja: このエディタのテーマ設定はどこにありますか？
en: Where is the theme setting in this editor?
alternatives: Where can I find the theme setting in this editor?
Where's the theme setting for this editor?
point: Where の後は is + 主語の語順にする
